issues.description: The template's state_preparation method for Exercise 4 declares the parameter state_of_lights as type str, but the problem statement and the solution expect a list of integers (list[int]) representing the board (e.g. [0,0,1,1]). Additionally, the template's grover_circuit method signature expects state_of_lights: list[int], which creates an internal inconsistency in the template itself. This mismatch can confuse students about the expected input type and will lead to type/signature mismatches when they implement the methods or follow the provided grover_circuit scaffold.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template signature of state_preparation to accept state_of_lights: list[int] (matching the problem statement and grover_circuit). Ensure all references and docstrings in the template describe state_of_lights as a list of integers. This will make the template internally consistent and aligned with the solution and exercise description.
